description: Source code implementation of the Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) optimizer in PyTorch, including options, state management, and serialization.

classes.name: SGDOptions
classes.description: Class representing options for the SGD optimizer, including learning rate, momentum, dampening, weight decay, and Nesterov momentum.

classes.name: SGDParamState
classes.description: Class managing the state of individual parameters during SGD optimization, primarily the momentum buffer.

classes.name: SGD
classes.description: Class implementing the SGD optimizer, including the step function, save, and load methods.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for SGDOptions and SGDParamState.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serialization methods for SGDOptions and SGDParamState.

methods.name: get_lr
methods.description: Returns the learning rate from SGDOptions.

methods.name: set_lr
methods.description: Sets the learning rate in SGDOptions.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Performs a single optimization step for the SGD optimizer.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the state of the SGD optimizer to an archive.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the state of the SGD optimizer from an archive.
